releases.title: Incident history on the status page
releases.description: Past incidents now appear below the changelog with their start time, duration and a short summary.

releases.title: Release dates rendered in the reader's locale
releases.description: Dates were shown as raw ISO strings in some browsers. They now use the visitor's locale formatting.

releases.title: Status badge with last-updated time
releases.description: The header card shows the current system status and when it was last updated, both read from the data file.

releases.title: Improved spacing on small screens
releases.description: Release cards and the incident timeline stack cleanly at phone width.

releases.title: Initial public release
releases.description: Pulse goes live as a static changelog page served from GitHub Pages, rendering releases from a JSON file.

incidents.title: Delayed page updates
incidents.summary: A misconfigured deployment published a stale build for about forty minutes. Re-running the deployment restored the current content.

incidents.title: Changelog failed to load
incidents.summary: A malformed JSON entry broke rendering. The entry was corrected and a validation step was added before publishing.
